======================================================================

ANNUAL FILE DETAILS
--------------------

*** DATA HAS NOT BEEN QUALITY CONTROLLED ***

The annual sea level data .zip file is named using the format
GGGG_ss_yyyy.zip (e.g. OTAT_40_2019.zip), where:

GGGG is the code for the monitoring site (eg OTAT, for Port Chalmers)
ss is sensor code (either 40 or 41)
yyyy is the year (eg 2019).

The .zip file contains a single file of sea level data for the year, 
named in the same format but using a .csv file extension.

The format of the sea level data in the annual .csv file is:
1st field: site code (eg OTAT)
2nd field: date (yyyymmdd) UTC
3rd field: time (hh:mm:ss) UTC, 24 hour
4th field: sea level height (metres)

e.g.:
OTAT,20190101,00:00:00,02.764
OTAT,20190101,00:01:00,02.753
OTAT,20190101,00:02:00,02.755

======================================================================

DAILY FILE DETAILS
-------------------

*** DATA HAS NOT BEEN QUALITY CONTROLLED ***

The daily sea level data .zip files are named using the format
GGGG_ss_yyyyddd.zip (e.g. OTAT_40_2019110.zip), where:

GGGG is the code for the monitoring site (eg OTAT, for Port Chalmers)
ss is sensor code (either 40 or 41)
yyyy is the year (eg 2019)
ddd is the day of the year (eg 110, for 20 April).

The .zip file contains a single file of sea level data for the day,
named in the same format but using a .csv file extension.

The format of the sea level data in the daily .csv file is:
1st field: site code (eg OTAT)
2nd field: date and time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm) UTC, 24 hour
3rd field: sea level height (metres)

e.g.:
OTAT,2019-04-20 00:00,5.251
OTAT,2019-04-20 00:01,5.257
OTAT,2019-04-20 00:02,5.263
